responsibilities: TaskWN0H8T measures actual browser trigger geometry and projects the trailing hidden root menus into the native MenuBarWindow::ImplCreatePopup parent-popup shape. Original command trees and submenu identities are retained;shared React menu state/dispatch/focus ownership remains unchanged. This does not certify complete native VCL parity.

Task1V60C3 applies MenuBarWindow constructor/ImplCreatePopup first-motion reset and MouseMove ordering to the actual shared root menubar. Enter-only input does not switch roots; closed motion updates rollover without consuming admission, leave clears rollover, floating popup events stay with their native window owner, and first active motion is ignored before valid neighboring-root switching. Native Paint priority highlights the active root, otherwise rollover; shared Writer geometry/colors remain. Browser DOM movement has no portable native IsSynthetic marker; full platform event synthesis, mnemonic/theme/window parity remains unverified.

Task1V60C3 also retains native highlighted-item ownership independently of root-popup existence: keyboard/focus activation paints the selected root,and admitted pointer movement in that state updates selection without creating a popup. F10 alone does not reset the existing first-motion flag;only actual popup creation does. This does not implement the pending native mouse-button-down contract.
